constraints.explanation: a plate face, texture and all, stays inside the height range above the deepest furrow

controls.explanation: Each plate of bark takes one of these tones.
controls.label: Plate colours

controls.explanation: The darker bark deep in a furrow.
controls.label: Furrow colour

controls.explanation: The pale green-grey of lichen on the plates.
controls.label: Lichen colour

controls.explanation: How many plates fit across one tile, around the trunk.
controls.label: Plates across

controls.explanation: How many plate lengths fit down one tile, along the trunk.
controls.label: Plates down

controls.explanation: How wide a furrow is, measured across the trunk.
controls.label: Furrow width

controls.explanation: How far a furrow sinks below the plates beside it.
controls.label: Furrow depth

controls.explanation: How far a furrow wanders sideways as it runs down the trunk.
controls.label: Furrow sway

controls.explanation: How many sideways wanders fit down one tile; more means tighter wanders.
controls.label: Sway length

controls.explanation: How many crack lengths fit across one tile; more means shorter cracks.
controls.label: Crack length

controls.explanation: How many cracks fit down one tile.
controls.label: Cracks down

controls.explanation: How wide a crack is, measured down the trunk.
controls.label: Crack width

controls.explanation: How deep a crack cuts into a plate, as a share of the furrow depth.
controls.label: Crack depth

controls.explanation: How far the fine texture on a plate face rises and falls.
controls.label: Plate texture

controls.explanation: How many bumps of the fine texture fit across one tile; more means finer texture.
controls.label: Plate texture size

controls.explanation: How much one plate differs in brightness from the next.
controls.label: Plate variation

controls.explanation: How completely lichen covers a plate where it grows, in percent.
controls.label: Lichen

controls.explanation: How many patches of lichen fit across one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Lichen patches

controls.explanation: How matte the bark is, in thousandths.
controls.label: Bark roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
